facts.big: Where does it go? · I’m going to…
facts.label: Limpar a geladeira
facts.sub: Mostre This yogurt is expired. Pergunte Where does it go? e Where do the vegetables go? Descreva There is mold on the top. Conte I’m going to wipe the shelves.

facts.label: Data de validade
facts.sub: Embalagens americanas mostram Best by, Use by ou Sell by. Best by indica qualidade, e Use by é o limite para consumir. Para laticínios e carnes, vale seguir a data com cuidado e checar o cheiro.

facts.label: Três lixeiras
facts.sub: Em cidades como Seattle, há três lixeiras: lixo comum, reciclagem e compostagem. Cada cidade tem regras diferentes, então vale ler os cartazes na lixeira e na cozinha antes de jogar algo fora.

facts.label: Sobras
facts.sub: Levar sobras do restaurante para casa é normal nos EUA, em uma caixinha chamada to-go box. Em casa, as pessoas guardam sobras em potes na geladeira e comem no dia seguinte, no almoço ou jantar.

facts.label: Dia de limpeza
facts.sub: Colegas de apartamento costumam dividir tarefas como limpar a geladeira. Combinam um dia, colocam música e fazem juntos. Terminar com uma pizza ou um café é uma recompensa comum.

compare.us: Nos EUA, muitas cidades separam lixo, reciclagem e compostagem em lixeiras diferentes.

pages.title: Where does it go? · 1/3
paragraphs: On Sunday afternoon, Ivy and her roommate Max open the fridge in their small Seattle apartment. Inside, they see a sad mix of old food, half-empty bottles and sticky spots on every shelf. Ivy takes out a carton of yogurt and checks the date on the side. It is expired, so she holds it away from her face and makes a funny sound. Max brings a big trash bag and puts music on the speaker. They decide to clean the whole fridge before dinner.
“The fridge is a mess. Let’s clean it today.” says Max. “Agreed. This yogurt is expired. Where does it go?” says Ivy. “In the trash. The empty carton goes in the recycling bin.” says Max.

pages.title: Where does it go? · 3/3
paragraphs: “Done. I’m going to wipe the shelves now.” says Ivy. “Perfect! Let’s order pizza after this.” says Max. Behind the milk, they find a plastic container full of old leftovers. Max opens the lid, and there is green mold on the rice. He tosses it into the compost bin outside, because food waste goes there. Ivy puts the fresh vegetables in the bottom drawer, where they stay cold and crisp. She wipes the sticky shelves with a wet sponge, and Max dries them with a towel. In the end the fridge is bright and almost empty, and they order a pizza to celebrate.
